ZEC.summary: NU7 mainnet is about 9 days out (block 3,543,405, around Nov 5): 25-second blocks, Sprout pool disabled and 60% of fees taken out of circulation. No vesting unlocks (PoW issuance only), so the main risk to the long is an upgrade slip.

news.title: NU7 roughly 10 days away: Sprout pool to be disabled, operators must run Zebra 7.0.0 before block 3,543,405
Privacy coins ZEC and XMR outperform Bitcoin on the week ahead of NU7, which cuts block time to 25s and sets aside 60% of fees
Zcash devs finalize NU7 mainnet activation height 3,543,405, targeting around Nov 5; ZEC up about 12%

MORPHO.summary: Adoption keeps growing, which supports the long: Bitso's new Bóvedas vaults run on Morpho and USDG lending on Morpho passed $115M in 18 days, on top of last week's Robinhood and Ledger integrations. The risk is the ~973K MORPHO stolen from institution-linked wallets that could be sold. No unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Mexican exchange Bitso launches Bóvedas, non-custodial USDC and MXNB yield vaults built on Morpho
USDG lending on Morpho (Arbitrum) passes $115M TVL within 18 days of launch
About 973K MORPHO stolen from two institution-linked addresses and routed to Tornado Cash; no protocol bug confirmed

DOT.summary: Headlines still lean against DOT, now trading near $1: the Fearless Wallet key leak, a near-empty relay chain after the Asset Hub move, and CoinShares redeeming its Stockholm Polkadot staking ETP on Nov 9, which could mean some DOT sold. No vesting unlocks; only regular issuance under the 2.1B cap.

news.title: CoinShares to redeem seven Stockholm-listed ETPs including its Polkadot staking product; last trading around Nov 4, redemption Nov 9
Relay chain nearly emptied after the Asset Hub migration; a referendum to rename to JAM fails
Fearless Wallet extension found leaking recovery phrases; users told to move funds after about 17K DOT taken

WCT.summary: Nothing material this week. Monthly unlocks fall on the 15th; the next (Nov 15) is outside the 14-day window.

LIT.summary: Still supportive for the long: a November CFTC license filing, new options and weETH collateral, and most fees going to LIT buybacks and burns. No unlocks in the next 14 days; the big team/investor cliff is later (late December per Tokenomist research).

news.title: Lighter adds ether.fi's weETH as perp collateral after launching 15-minute BTC/ETH up/down options
Lighter routes almost all of ~$2.8M monthly revenue into LIT buybacks; LIT stalls below $4
Lighter founder says it will apply for US CFTC derivatives licenses in November; LIT up about 23% on the week

ANIME.summary: No material news this week (up about 5% on the week). No unlocks in the next 14 days; the next is Nov 23 (about 130M ANIME, ~1.3% of supply, to Community Cultivation), outside the window.

BERA.summary: No material news this week. DefiLlama lists no BERA unlocks scheduled after Oct 25; only ongoing validator and reward-vault emissions, which add a little supply.
